decisions.reason: Grounded in fixture: identifies the disabled expression, busy as a useState local of sibling AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips (free identifier -> ReferenceError), the length===0 early return null before the map, and the plain-phase falsy left operand that evaluates busy via ||. All essential requirements covered.

Explains the render exception is caught by the slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry (no per-button degradation), the separate input.left attach-button slot entry survives, and the diagnostic appears only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses shipped v0.2.10 source plus the maintainer note to establish busy already existed in the baseline; proposes rollback/re-add bisect and a minimal data-present plain-phase mount on v0.2.10. Refuses to blame the hover diff, grounding the diff-vs-baseline inconsistency (stale base) and calling out the hoisted imageItem line referencing callback-scoped status/record; no overclaim about historical first-failure timing is forced.

Removes the dangling busy reference (or lifts owned state via props), preserves the phase guard, hardens record?.items ?? [], and scopes the imageItem computation back inside the callback where record/status are defined. But the DOM-target hardening event.target.closest?.() omits a guard on event.target itself (the rubric's event.target?.closest?.(...) or equivalent type check), so one named hardening is incomplete.

Proposes a render/mount test with an occurrence present in phase 'plain' asserting the chip renders and no error-boundary capture fires; explains the empty state early-returns past the throwing line and that node --check only parses without resolving free identifiers or executing the component; requires a data-present slot render smoke as a pre-ship gate.
